Each front/rear glove has exactly four separated fingers and one opposed thumb, confirmed in all four native hand crops.
Front gloves have padded palm/thumb-root surfaces; rear gloves show stitched backs and finger seams rather than duplicated oval palm pads.
Both side gloves present end-on fingertips with thumb above, agreeing with the same straight wrists and horizontal arms of the front/rear T-pose.
Crossing riveted straps remain attached to the vest; hip pouches stay at the hips, with coherent side visibility and belt attachment across front, rear and profiles.
Two legs, winter boot cuffs, complete boots and grounded soles are visible and coherent in all four views.

source_interpretation_limit: The Atlas supplies a small source appearance; hidden reverse seams and fittings are authored consistent interpretation, not native model evidence.
